title: MESPOM Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Program (2027-2029)
institution: MESPOM consortium (Master of Science in Environmental Sciences, Policy and Management)
about: Erasmus Mundus joint master's programme in environmental sciences, policy and management, 2027-2029 intake.
